title: CLI Release Readiness Rules
description: Minimum release gates for Evolith CLI, SDK, and MCP exposure.

rules.title: TypeScript Build Must Pass
rules.description: The CLI package MUST compile with npm run build before any release candidate is tagged.
rules.validationQuery: Run npm run build in sdk/cli and require exit code 0.

rules.title: Unit and Integration Tests Must Start and Pass
rules.description: The CLI test runner MUST start successfully and all non-quarantined tests MUST pass.
rules.validationQuery: Run npm test -- --runInBand in sdk/cli and require exit code 0.

rules.title: Dependency Graph Must Be Reproducible
rules.description: The CLI workspace MUST keep a committed package lock and no missing transitive dependencies.
rules.validationQuery: Run npm install --workspace @beyondnet/evolith-cli, npm ls, and verify package-lock.json is present.

rules.title: MCP Smoke Test Must Pass
rules.description: The MCP server MUST respond to initialize and tools/list over the supported release transport.
rules.validationQuery: Start evolith-mcp and execute initialize plus tools/list JSON-RPC smoke requests.

rules.title: Release Documentation Must Match Implementation
rules.description: CLI README, architecture, vision, gap analysis, and parity docs SHOULD describe the current implemented state without contradictions.
rules.validationQuery: Review CLI documentation state markers against source commands and tests.
